value.rationale: The order-seven translation is a canonical transitive subgroup of the seven-label automorphism group of the first nontrivial triple Kneser complex. Its fixed geometric topology is disconnected even though the ambient complex has vanishing reduced H0 (and rational homology only in high degrees); the normalizer carries a nontrivial quadratic integral degree-zero character. This provides an exact, structurally motivated equivariant datum not recoverable from ambient Betti numbers and relevant to fixed-point and Lefschetz comparisons.
